Asha (Product): Quick ask for M4 owners 1: please post a one-line status: shipped/slipped + ETA + one-line blocker. I need this for the exec summary tomorrow morning.
Miguel (Eng - Runtime): Shipped 1: batching autoscaler v2 rolled, docs + rollout done. ETA: 48h monitoring. Next: watch token cost. @Asha
Priya (Eng - Platform): Slipped 1: Dedicated capacity UI. Blocker: SSO metadata mismatch from identity. Owner: Priya. ETA: tentative EOW if identity patch lands.
Dan (SRE): Shipped 1: canary policy failover automation. Observed ~2s P99 reduction on canary path. Next: add alert for policy mismatch diffs.
Jordan (PM, Dedicated): Priya 1: can you add the SSO failure note to the milestone doc so I can brief GTM/stakeholders?
Priya (Eng - Platform): Added to doc and pinged identity. Snippet below:
```
AuthError: provider metadata missing 'jwks_uri'
service: idp-redwood-prod
trace: 0x9abf
```
Mei (Eng - ML infra): Slipped 1: quantization pipeline for M4. Accuracy regression on eval set after last PR. Owner: Mei. ETA: 3 business days to isolate + rerun evals. Suspect seed/state change.
Connor (Eng - Runtime): Shipped 1: kernel selection heuristics for LlamaX reduced mem ~12% in CI. Next: build canary image and push to Dedicated. Tag: `runtime:v2-kh-202603`. @infra-team FYI.
Asha (Product): Quick summary: shipped = Miguel, Dan, Connor. slipped = Priya (UI/SSO), Mei (quant). Owners: please add a line in milestone doc under M4 like `owner 1 shipped/slipped 1 ETA 1 blocker` by EOD.
Miguel (Eng - Runtime): Done in doc, noted 48h watch.
Priya (Eng - Platform): Doc updated with SSO context + identity ticket link. Marked P1; escalated.
Mei (Eng - ML infra): Doc updated with suspected seed cause and next steps.
Jordan (PM, Dedicated): If SSO patch delays beyond EOW, recommend soft-launch with manual ops tunnel for affected customers. Dan, can SRE support manual gating?
Dan (SRE): Yes. We can gate via a feature flag: `dedicated_ui_sso_v1` and provide manual onboarding steps. Will draft runbook.
Connor (Eng - Runtime): Pushed image tag plan to infra; will trigger canary once image is available.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy `runtime:v2-kh-202603` scheduled for 2623467200 1 trigger: @Connor
Asha (Product): Thanks everyone 1 I'll pull together the exec snapshot first thing. :thumbsup:
